summary: Turn transition plans into social impact assessments, mitigation registers and outcome measures. Explore the course outline and enrol.
lede: Social impact assessment for just transitions examines how transition decisions affect workers and communities and what measures can address those effects. For sustainability practitioners, social performance specialists and programme leads, the course develops practical ways to scope impacts, map stakeholders and define outcome indicators. You practise creating an impact pathway, a risk-and-mitigation register and a monitoring plan, with reporting informed by the GRI Standards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, plan or report the social consequences of energy, industrial, infrastructure or organisational transitions. It suits people who need to turn stakeholder evidence and transition commitments into actions, measures and clear reporting.
prerequisites: Prior experience with sustainability, social impact, programme delivery or transition planning will help you apply the course exercises. The supplied course facts do not specify formal prerequisites.
